t: Casting Spells: A Simpler Magic for AI Tool-Calling
s: This article proposes a lightweight approach to AI tool-calling using simple, command-line-style 'magic words' (e.g., '[ls]') as a form of progressive enhancement, making it more accessible for smaller LLMs and an alternative to verbose JSON-based protocols like MCP.
sub: Model Context Protocol (MCP) and its limitations
The role of language in AI automation and understanding
